title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant / Conveyancing Administrator

Location: Leeds
Salary: £25,000 - £30,000 per annum (depending on experience)
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:45am - 5:30pm (Office based)

About the Opportunity

An established and well-respected legal practice in Leeds is seeking an organised and proactive Conveyancing Assistant / Conveyancing Administrator to join its busy Residential Conveyancing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with previous conveyancing support experience to develop their career within a supportive and professional environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in assisting fee earners with residential property transactions, ensuring matters progress efficiently from instruction through to completion.

Key Responsibilities
- Acting as a key point of contact for clients, estate agents, lenders and solicitors.
- Opening new client files and carrying out AML and compliance checks.
- Requesting searches, title documents and redemption statements.
- Preparing conveyancing documentation and contract packs.
- Assisting fee earners throughout the exchange and completion process.
- Updating and maintaining accurate records on the case management system.
- Monitoring transaction progress and proactively following up outstanding matters.
- Delivering a high standard of client care and professional communication at all times.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience within a Conveyancing Assistant, Conveyancing Administrator or Legal Assistant position.
- Knowledge of residential conveyancing processes, including freehold and leasehold transactions.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied workload.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and prioritise competing deadlines.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £25,000 - £30,000 depending on experience.
- Free on-site parking.
- Company pension scheme.
- Cycle to Work scheme.
- Regular team and social events.
- 22 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service.
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Conveyancing Assistant or Conveyancing Administrator looking for your next opportunity within a reputable legal practice, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Mobility Claims Paralegal
description:
Role: Mobility Claims Paralegal
Location: Leeds City Centre
Salary: £25,000 - £32,000 DOE + Bonus & Benefits
Working Pattern: Hybrid Working
Hours: Full-time, Permanent

The Opportunity

CRA Consulting are working with a leading UK legal and insurance business looking to recruit an experienced RTA Claims Handler or Paralegal into its specialist Mobility Claims team in Leeds.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience handling Road Traffic Accident personal injury claims who enjoys combining technical claims work with delivering a high standard of customer service.

You will manage your own RTA caseload, including claims progressing through the Official Injury Claim (OIC) and Ministry of Justice (MOJ) portals. Depending on experience, this could include both litigated and non-litigated matters.

Alongside a salary of up to £32,000, the position offers a 6% annual bonus opportunity, employer pension contribution of up to 14% and an excellent wider benefits package.

The Role

Joining an established Claims team within the wider Legal Services department, you will help customers progress their RTA claims efficiently and achieve fair outcomes.

The role has a particular focus on claims involving mobility vehicles, with responsibility for files from instruction through to settlement.

Responsibilities include:
- Managing your own RTA personal injury caseload
- Handling OIC, MOJ and non-portal claims
- Managing litigated and non-litigated matters depending on experience
- Progressing claims from instruction to settlement
- Reviewing liability, medical evidence, quantum and settlement proposals
- Obtaining evidence required to progress claims
- Liaising with customers, insurers and legal representatives
- Explaining legal and technical information clearly to customers
- Maintaining accurate case management records
- Working towards agreed quality, service and performance standards
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and customer experience

This is a customer-focused position, so you will need to combine good technical RTA knowledge with excellent communication and client-care skills.

What Are They Looking For?

I am keen to speak with candidates currently working as an RTA Claims Handler, OIC/MOJ Claims Handler, RTA Paralegal, Personal Injury Fee Earner, RTA Litigator, Claims Negotiator or Litigation Executive.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous RTA personal injury claims experience
- Knowledge of the OIC and/or MOJ portal
- Experience managing your own caseload
- Understanding of liability, quantum and medical evidence
- Strong communication and client-care skills
- Good organisation and file-management abilities
- Ability to manage competing deadlines
- Experience working towards quality or performance targets

Litigation experience would be advantageous but isn't essential for every appointment.

If you meet most, but not all, of the criteria, I would still be interested in speaking with you.

Salary & Benefits

The package is particularly strong and includes:
- £25,000 - £32,000 salary DOE
- 6% annual bonus opportunity
- Employer pension contribution of up to 14%, depending on your contribution
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Option to buy or sell up to five days' holiday
- Employer-funded private medical benefit
- Up to 40% discount on company insurance products
- Additional retailer discounts
- Up to £1,200 of free shares annually through the Matching Share Plan
- Save As You Earn share scheme
- Three paid volunteering days each year
- Parental and carer's leave policies
- Flexible benefits including cycle to work
- Wellbeing support and resources
- High-quality IT equipment
- Part-time and job-share applications considered

Hybrid Working

The business operates a smart-working model combining home working with time alongside colleagues in Leeds.

Most employees are expected to spend at least 50% of their working time in the office each week, with flexibility around hours, part-time arrangements and job shares open to discussion.

The Business

Our client is a major UK legal and insurance business with an established customer base and strong reputation.

The organisation continues to invest in its people, technology and customer service and, due to increasing work volumes, is expanding its Leeds claims operation.

For somebody looking for stability, excellent benefits and the opportunity to develop their RTA claims career within a recognised national organisation, this is well worth exploring.

About CRA Consulting

CRA Consulting are specialist legal recruiters working with law firms, legal services providers and in-house legal teams across the UK.

We recruit from support and paralegal level through to solicitors, directors, partners and board-level appointments.

We take the time to understand your experience and career plans before introducing you to an employer.

How to Apply

If you are interested, apply through the advert or contact Rob Addy at CRA Consulting on for a confidential conversation.

title: Paralegal
description:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for a Paralegal with a minimum of 6 months' previous conveyancing experience to join a highly regarded Securitisation team in Leeds.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to develop their career within a busy and established Securitisation team, working alongside experienced Solicitors and Partners on a varied caseload and supporting transactions from initial instruction through to completion.

Previous conveyancing experience of at least 6 months is essential and non-negotiable.

The Role

Working as part of the Property team, responsibilities will include:
- Supporting Solicitors and Partners with a varied portfolio of property transactions
- Managing allocated tasks across files and taking responsibility for progressing work to agreed deadlines
- Reviewing property titles and obtaining Official Copy Entries and other Land Registry documentation
- Carrying out property due diligence, searches and title checks
- Liaising with Land Registry, Local Authorities, clients and other third parties to obtain required information
- Chasing outstanding documentation and ensuring files continue to progress
- Assisting with pre-completion searches and post-completion matters
- Providing regular updates to Solicitors and clients on the progress of transactions
- Monitoring deadlines and prioritising a busy workload
- Supporting colleagues within the wider team when required
- Maintaining accurate records and following established legal and departmental procedures

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- A minimum of 6 months' previous conveyancing experience - essential
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills
- Experience managing a busy workload and prioritising competing deadlines
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- A professional and approachable telephone manner
- Strong administration skills and the ability to maintain accurate records
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook
- The ability to work independently while also being a supportive team player
- A methodical, proactive and commercially minded approach
- The confidence to communicate with clients, Solicitors and other stakeholders

A Law degree or equivalent would be advantageous, as would experience of CILEx, the LPC or working within a Document Management System, but these are not essential.

What's on Offer?
- £27,000 salary
- Bonus based on billings
- Permanent position
- Leeds-based legal team
- Excellent opportunity to develop within a highly respected property environment
- Varied and interesting caseload
- Supportive and experienced team
- Opportunity to build on existing property/conveyancing experience and progress your legal career

Please note: applicants must have a minimum of 6 months' previous property or conveyancing experience to be considered for this position.

title: Remote Conveyancing Paralegal
company: LEGAL TALENT PARTNERS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Remote Conveyancing Paralegal

£

Quality. Technology. Flexibility. A Better Way to Do Conveyancing.

We're partnering with a fast-growing, forward-thinking residential conveyancing firm that is using technology, smarter processes and a collaborative team structure to change the way property law is delivered.

The firm is built around a simple idea: conveyancing should be simpler, clearer and faster - for clients and the people delivering it.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for greater autonomy, better technology, a sustainable workload and the flexibility of a fully remote role, this could be an excellent next move.

Why This Role Stands Out

This is not a traditional conveyancing environment where paralegals are left to manage overwhelming caseloads with little support.

You'll work within small, collaborative teams, with regular check-ins, structured 1-to-1s, feedback and personalised training.

The firm takes a quality over quantity approach to workload, maintaining sustainable caseloads and giving teams capacity to deal with peaks without compromising client service.

You'll benefit from:
- Sustainable caseloads and a strong focus on work-life balance
- Small, collaborative teams
- Regular support, feedback and development
- Bespoke technology designed around legal teams
- A culture where asking for help is encouraged
- The opportunity to influence how technology and processes develop
- Fully remote working with genuine flexibility

The result? A more manageable workload, better support and the freedom to focus on delivering excellent conveyancing rather than simply processing as many files as possible.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Paralegal, you'll be an integral part of a residential conveyancing team, working alongside lawyers and other paralegals to deliver an excellent client service.

You'll work across freehold and leasehold sales, purchases and remortgages, taking ownership of your matters while working collaboratively with the wider team.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Progressing residential sales, purchases and remortgages
- Handling freehold sales with minimal supervision
- Managing most leasehold sale enquiries with minimal supervision
- Managing most freehold purchase enquiries with minimal supervision
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and other third parties
- Proactively identifying issues and keeping transactions moving
- Reviewing and responding to enquiries
- Maintaining clear, jargon-free communication
- Using the firm's technology to manage your caseload efficiently
- Identifying and resolving potential issues before they become blockers
- Providing feedback to improve systems and processes

The firm's technology has been developed specifically around its conveyancing process, and legal professionals are encouraged to provide feedback on the tools they use every day.

About you

You'll ideally have:
- Strong experience in residential conveyancing
- Experience handling freehold sales with limited supervision
- Experience dealing with leasehold sale enquiries
- Experience dealing with freehold purchase enquiries
- Confidence communicating with clients and third parties
- A proactive approach to progressing transactions
- Strong organisation and attention to detail
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Confidence working independently in a remote environment
- An interest in using technology to improve legal work

You don't need to be qualified. This role is suited to an experienced paralegal with strong technical conveyancing skills who is ready to take greater ownership of their work.

Although fully remote, you won't be left alone with a laptop and a pile of files. Regular team check-ins, 1-to-1s and ongoing feedback are built into the firm's approach.

The Culture:

This is a firm deliberately doing things differently.

Rather than chasing maximum utilisation, it takes a sustainable approach to workload, helping teams maintain consistent service levels while giving people room to deal with the unexpected.

Its technology helps allocate work, streamline processes and keep teams informed, while its remote-working model is built around communication, supervision, feedback and development.

There's also a strong culture of transparency and continuous improvement. People are encouraged to share ideas, challenge processes and help shape the future of the business.

The Package
- £30,000-£40,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the UK
- Flexible working hours
- 25 days' holiday + 3 days at Christmas + Bank Holidays
- Full home-working setup and equipment provided
- Comprehensive private healthcare
- Free access to Spill mental health and wellbeing support
- Company pension scheme
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave
- Growth Shares, giving employees an opportunity to share in the long-term success of the business
- Fully paid-for annual company weekend
- Structured development and genuine progression opportunities

The firm's flexible approach is a key part of its culture, with many employees working flexible hours or part-time. The focus is on creating working patterns that work for both the individual and the wider team.

If you're an experienced conveyancing paralegal looking for a genuinely modern, supportive and flexible place to build your career, we'd love to hear from you.
